dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Yes, I'm referring to you. The vast majority of visitors here are in big business, so I've become accustomed to speaking politely.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: What's more, the master here has made it clear, if you want to be in business, you be polite to everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: If you treat people by their appearances, one day you're going to offend someone very important.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Call it a business principle of the Feiyun Commerce Guild if you will.
